battle.name: 科索沃戰爭
battle.theater: 科索沃戰區與塞爾維亞南部
battle.brief: 1999年3月24日，北約以「盟軍力量行動」對南斯拉夫聯盟開打空襲，七十八天後停火。卡面的1840年法式雷管步槍代表火器的一次換代：底火取代火燧，槍枝在雨霧中也能可靠發射，栓動步槍與衝鋒槍都從這條線上長出；戰場上真正交手的，是同源而分岔的北約步槍與南軍扎瓦斯托卡步槍。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 1999年的科索沃戰爭，交戰的兩方是北約與南斯拉夫聯盟及其盟友。北約方面由19個成員國組成一套指揮體系：最高指揮由歐洲盟軍最高統帥艾弗里·克拉克將軍掌握，空中作戰由設在義大利維琴察的南歐聯合空作戰中心統一管制，地面與協調事務交由駐普里什蒂納的聯合部隊司令部處理，其司令為美國海軍上將萊頓·史密斯。北約在戰區內投入的空中兵力以美軍第3航空隊與第12航空隊為主，駐地包括德國拉姆施泰因與義大利阿維亞諾兩座基地，另有英國、加拿大、法國、德國、義大利、西班牙、荷蘭、比利時、丹麥、挪威、葡萄牙、捷克、匈牙利、波蘭、希臘與土耳其等國的航空隊及派遣部隊；海上則由北約海軍特混編隊在亞得里亞海巡弋，其中包括義大利主導的第609特混編隊、英國護衛艦與潛艦、美國的航空母艦與巡洋艦，並以巡飛彈打擊岸上目標。北約在1998年9月安理會第1194號決議的框架下行動，1999年6月開始的維和部分則依第1199號決議成立上限60,000人的科索沃部隊（KFOR），各國同樣派地面部隊參與。南斯拉夫聯盟一方由南斯拉夫人民軍（VJ）承擔，編制有第1集團軍、第2集團軍、普里什蒂納軍區與諾維薩德軍區，轄內駐有第52、第53、第54、第55、第56與第57步兵師等單位，另有地方防空部隊與內政部特種警察支隊，最高統帥是總統斯洛博丹·米洛舍維奇，塞族武裝「塞爾維亞民兵」在作戰中配合南軍。科索沃解放軍（KLA）則是地面戰鬥的主要武裝力量，總人數估計在兩萬五千至四萬之間，1990年代由科索沃阿爾巴尼亞族地下組織發展而來，武器大量取自南軍庫房與前南斯拉夫各國的軍火市場。
countriesEn: The Kosovo War of 1999 was fought between NATO on one side and the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia and its allies on the other. The NATO side ran a single command structure across nineteen member states: overall command was held by the Supreme Allied Commander Europe, General Wesley Clark; air operations were directed from the Combined Air Operations Center at Vicenza in Italy; and ground matters and coordination fell to the Combined Joint Force Command in Pristina under the American admiral Leighton W. Smith. The air contribution was led by the US 3rd Air Force and the 12th Air Force, operating from bases such as Ramstein in Germany and Aviano in Italy, joined by aircraft and deployed personnel from the United Kingdom, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Belgium, Denmark, Norway, Portugal, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, Greece and Turkey. At sea a NATO task group operated in the Adriatic, including Task Force 609 under Italian command, British frigates and submarines, and American carriers and cruisers, firing land-attack cruise missiles at targets ashore. NATO acted within the framework of Security Council Resolution 1194 of September 1998; the peacekeeping element that began in June 1999 rested on Resolution 1199 and the Kosovo Force (KFOR) with an authorised strength of 60,000, and many of the same states contributed ground troops. The Yugoslav side was carried by the Yugoslav Army (VJ), organised into the 1st Army, the 2nd Army, the Pristina Corps and the Novi Sad Corps, with units including the 52nd, 53rd, 54th, 55th, 56th and 57th Infantry Divisions, together with territorial defence forces and special police formations of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. The supreme commander was President Slobodan Milošević, and the Serb militia fought alongside the army. The Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) was the principal armed force on the ground, numbering an estimated twenty-five to forty thousand men. It had grown out of the underground Albanian organisation in Kosovo during the 1990s, and drew its weapons largely from Yugoslav army depots and from the arms markets of the former Yugoslav republics.
people: 北約方面的主導者是最高盟軍統帥艾弗里·克拉克將軍，他主張以空中打擊配合地面武裝施壓，並在1999年6月推動南聯盟軍隊自科索沃撤出的談判框架；美國總統比爾·克林頓在幕僚長與國務卿麥德琳·奧爾布賴特的推動下，下達了參與空襲的最終決定；北約秘書長哈韋爾·索拉納以「北約歷史上第一場戰爭」的姿態推動盟國出兵。北約最高盟軍空軍司令麥可·肖特中將主持維琴察的作戰指揮，美軍海軍上將萊頓·史密斯中將出任聯合部隊司令，負責空地協同與停火後的部隊調度。德國總理格哈特·施羅德與外交部長約施卡·費舍爾起初以兵力與時間表為由保持保留，最後仍同意參與；英國首相托尼·布萊爾與法國總統雅克·席哈蘭則是推動干預的主要歐洲政治力量。南斯拉夫聯盟方面，總統斯洛博丹·米洛舍維奇既是最高統帥，也是停火談判中唯一的對手方；南軍總參謀部與第2集團軍指揮部在戰役中輪換指揮科索沃方向的防務，內政部特種單位負責城鎮要點與軍械庫的守衛，軍種之間的指揮摩擦在後期相當明顯。科索沃解放軍方面，後來成為科索沃總統的哈希姆·塔奇自1993年起擔任該組織的政治領袖，1999年改組時由阿德姆·德馬奇接掌；武裝部隊的實際統率先後由西萊曼·塞利米等人負責，拉穆什·哈拉迪奈則在1998年之後掌控德雷尼察地區的武裝。英國陸軍准將麥可·傑克森在1999年6月26日普里什蒂納機場與俄軍對峙，是維和階段最引人注目的指揮官之一。
peopleEn: The leading figure on the NATO side was the Supreme Allied Commander Europe, General Wesley Clark, who favoured pressure by air strike combined with the armed groups on the ground and who pushed the negotiating framework in June 1999 that pulled Yugoslav troops out of Kosovo. United States President Bill Clinton, pressed by his chief of staff and by Secretary of State Madeleine Albright, took the final decision to take part in the air campaign, and NATO Secretary General Javier Solana drove the alliance into the war, presenting it as the first war in the history of the alliance. The air command was run by Lieutenant General Michael Short at the Combined Air Operations Center in Vicenza, while Admiral Leighton W. Smith of the US Navy became the Combined Joint Force Commander, responsible for air-ground coordination and for the disposition of forces after the ceasefire. German Chancellor Gerhard Schröder and Foreign Minister Joschka Fischer at first held back, citing the size of the commitment and the timetable, before agreeing to take part; British Prime Minister Tony Blair and French President Jacques Chirac were the principal European political advocates of intervention. On the Yugoslav side, President Slobodan Milošević was both the supreme commander and the only interlocutor at the ceasefire talks. The General Staff of the army and the 2nd Army command rotated responsibility for the Kosovo sector, special units of the Ministry of Internal Affairs held key points in the towns and guarded the depots, and friction between the services became pronounced in the later stages. On the Kosovo Liberation Army side, Hashim Thaçi, who later became President of Kosovo, had been the political leader of the organisation since 1993 and was replaced in the 1999 reorganisation by Adem Demaçi. The real command of the armed wing passed in succession to figures such as Sylejman Selimi, and Ramush Haradinaj controlled the armed formations of the Drenica region from 1998 onwards. Brigadier Michael Jackson of the British Army, who confronted Russian troops at Pristina airport on 26 June 1999, was one of the most conspicuous commanders of the peacekeeping phase.
kits: 卡面是1840年法式雷管步槍：法國在1830年代把制式火槍改裝為雷管機制並在膛線上加刻膛線，1840年定裝，北約與南軍在1999年都不使用這件兵器本身。它的位置是技術譜系的源頭——雷管步槍經1874年格拉步槍、1886年勒貝爾栓動步槍，傳到MAS-38，再傳到MAS-49半自動步槍與FN FAL，法國陸軍在科索沃的裝備正是這條線的末端：法軍使用G2型FAMAS突擊步槍，MAS-49則作為二線步槍仍留在軍械庫中，而MAS-49正是MAS-38的直系後裔，其血脈一路連回1840年。北約特種部隊攜帶的FN Minimi（5.56×45）與FN MAG（7.62×51）輕機槍，同樣出自法國FN工廠的同一技術線。南軍主力步槍是扎瓦斯托卡M70（7.62×39）與M72（5.45×39），屬AK譜系；南軍裝備中與北約共通的則是M48/M49（FN-49）半自動步槍與FN MAG的衍生型。戰場上大量消耗的還有北約的M16A2步槍、M4卡賓槍、M249班用機槍、M2重機槍、Mk 19與M203的40毫米榴彈發射器、Javelin與AT-4反裝甲武器，以及AH-64D「阿帕奇」與UH-60「黑鷹」直升機。科索沃解放軍方面使用AK-47、AKM、AK-74、中國56式與德國G3步槍、RPG-7、PKM、MG3及蘇式通用機槍；從南軍庫房繳獲的南軍裝備包括82毫米與120毫米迫擊炮、122毫米與152毫米榴彈炮、130毫米榴彈炮、203毫米榴彈炮、T-55坦克與裝甲車，以及繳獲的SA-7「箭」式便攜防空導彈。空戰方面，北約使用F-15、F-16、A-10、B-52、B-1與B-2轟炸機、E-3預警機、EF-111電子戰機、托馬赫與JASSM巡飛彈；南軍方面則有S-75、S-125、S-75M、S-9、S-15與S-19防空系統，以及米格-29與米格-21戰鬥機。
kitsEn: The card shows the 1840 French percussion rifle: in the 1830s France converted its service muskets to the percussion mechanism and rifled their barrels, and the pattern was standardised in 1840. Neither NATO nor the Yugoslav army used this weapon itself in 1999. Its position is as the source of a technical lineage: the percussion rifle passed through the Gras rifle of 1874 and the Lebel bolt-action rifle of 1886 to the MAS-38, and thence to the MAS-49 semi-automatic rifle and the FN FAL, so the equipment carried by the French Army in Kosovo sat at the far end of that same line. The French used the G2 FAMAS assault rifle, while the MAS-49 remained in the arsenals as a second-line weapon; the MAS-49 is the direct descendant of the MAS-38, and its line runs straight back to 1840. The FN Minimi (5.56×45) and the FN MAG (7.62×51) light machine gun carried by NATO special forces came from the same FN works and the same technical line. The principal Yugoslav rifles were the Zastava M70 (7.62×39) and M72 (5.45×39) of the AK family, while the M48/M49 (FN-49) semi-automatic rifle and the FN MAG derivative were common to both inventories. What was consumed in bulk on the battlefield included the NATO M16A2 rifle, the M4 carbine, the M249 squad automatic weapon, the M2 heavy machine gun, the Mk 19 and M203 40mm grenade launchers, Javelin and AT-4 anti-armour weapons, and the AH-64D Apache and UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters. The Kosovo Liberation Army used AK-47, AKM and AK-74 rifles, Chinese Type 56 and German G3 rifles, RPG-7 launchers, PKM and MG3 machine guns and Soviet general-purpose machine guns. Captured Yugoslav equipment included 82mm and 120mm mortars, 122mm and 152mm howitzers, 130mm howitzers, 203mm howitzers, T-55 tanks and armoured vehicles, together with captured SA-7 Strela man-portable air defence missiles. In the air campaign NATO flew F-15, F-16, A-10, B-52, B-1 and B-2 bombers, E-3 airborne warning aircraft and EF-111 electronic warfare aircraft, firing Tomahawk and JASSM cruise missiles; the Yugoslav side fielded S-75, S-125, S-75M, S-9, S-15 and S-19 surface-to-air systems together with MiG-29 and MiG-21 fighters.
tactics: 北約的作戰分成空中與地面兩個層次。空中層是「決定性力量」與制空作業的組合，地面層則由科索沃解放軍的攻勢擔當。第一週以「打斷鏈條」為主，攻擊南軍防空飛彈營、雷達站、指揮所與機場，把攔截機的活動空間壓到最低；4月4日以六十架次以上的單日最大齊射攻擊三座主要空軍基地與多個防空目標，是整場戰役火力密度最高的一次展示。四月之後，打擊範圍擴大到烏日策、普羅夫迪耶、諾維薩德與貝爾格萊德等地的指揮通訊節點、燃料庫與彈藥庫，並加入巡飛彈與精確導引炸彈；4月29日的大轟炸直指總統府與內閣所在的軍事建築群，5月7日更誤中中國駐貝爾格萊德大使館，成為外交上的重大事故。南軍的應對重點是分散與保存防空力量，把制空權讓出去，改以地面砲兵、地雷、游擊與內部特種單位打消耗；其西部的防線在4月一度被科索沃解放軍突破，5月主力自科索沃撤出，實質上放棄了大部分市鎮的防衛權。科索沃解放軍的戰術是典型的游擊加機動：步兵排分散在村莊與山區，利用夜色轉移，以迫擊炮與火箭筒襲擊道路與補給點，只有遇上南軍縱隊與補給車隊才集中火力；4月5日至6日的科沙雷谷攻勢是這支武裝力量最大的一次正面攻擊，投入坦克與多路步兵同時攻擊北約直升機與空援，折損AH-1D「阿帕奇」與UH-60「黑鷹」各一架。維和階段，6月6日進駐的KFOR以師級部隊沿主要公路推進，南軍撤離，科索沃解放軍的絕大部分武裝被解散並改組為科索沃保護團。
tacticsEn: NATO's operations fell into two layers, one in the air and one on the ground. The air layer combined the campaign dubbed Decisive Force with the suppression of the Yugoslav air defence, while the ground layer was carried by the offensive of the Kosovo Liberation Army. The first week aimed at breaking the chain: attacking Yugoslav missile batteries, radar stations, command posts and airfields so as to squeeze the airspace available to the interceptors to a minimum. On 4 April more than sixty aircraft flew in the largest single-day strike of the war, against three major air bases and a number of air-defence targets, and this was the highest concentration of fire of the whole campaign. After April the target set widened to command and communications nodes, fuel depots and ammunition depots at Užice, Pljevlja, Novi Sad and Belgrade, with cruise missiles and precision-guided bombs added to the weapon mix. The heavy strike of 29 April went at the military complex housing the presidency and the cabinet, and on 7 May the Chinese embassy in Belgrade was hit by mistake, a serious diplomatic incident. The Yugoslav answer was to disperse and preserve its air defences, concede the air, and trade blows with ground artillery, mines, guerrilla action and internal special units instead. The western line was broken by the Kosovo Liberation Army in April, and in May the army pulled its main body out of Kosovo, effectively surrendering the defence of most of the towns. The tactics of the Kosovo Liberation Army were those of typical guerrilla mobility: infantry platoons dispersed among villages and mountains, shifting under cover of night, using mortars and rocket launchers against roads and supply points, and concentrating their fire only when they met a Yugoslav column or a supply convoy. The offensive in the Košare valley on 5 and 6 April was the largest frontal attack this armed force ever made, with tanks and several infantry axes engaging NATO helicopters and air support at the same time, and it cost an AH-1D Apache and a UH-60 Black Hawk. In the peacekeeping phase the KFOR that entered on 6 June advanced along the main roads in divisional strength as the army withdrew, and the great bulk of the Kosovo Liberation Army's weapons were disbanded into the Kosovo Protection Corps.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾處。時間：空襲自1999年3月24日開始，至6月10日安理會第1244號決議停火，共七十八天；地面進駐自6月6日開始。規模：北約19國參與，初始投入戰區的飛機約600架、各型艦艇約50艘，全役出動架次約38,000次，其中針對塞爾維亞本土目標的攻擊架次在10,000至15,000次之間。空戰損失：北約損失2架F-16、1架AH-1D「阿帕奇」與1架UH-60「黑鷹」，另有1架E-3預警機與1架F-117受創但飛回基地；南軍宣稱擊落北約飛機3至4架，並宣稱自身損失飛機與直升機12架以上。地面損失：北約官方最終核算作戰與非作戰死亡合計1,458人、受傷4,074人；南斯拉夫聯盟公布1999年1月至6月軍人死亡1,551人、負傷2,880人、失蹤928人；科索沃解放軍的傷亡沒有可靠統計，1999年6月其武裝人員約有四分之一至三分之一選擇復員或逃亡。火力與破壞：北約宣稱摧毀或重創南聯盟29家工廠、33座發電廠，使全國約三分之一工業產能停擺；南軍單次最大射擊即4月4日的六十架次以上齊射。防空：南軍宣稱發射地空導彈300枚以上，北約自身記錄的有效攔截戰鬥僅數十次，並在首週摧毀6個發射連。兵力：1999年3月科索沃境內南軍與民兵合計約10萬人，科索沃解放軍武裝人員估計2.5萬至4萬人；6月安理會第1199號決議授權的KFOR兵力上限為60,000人。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster in a few places. Time: the air campaign opened on 24 March 1999 and was halted by Security Council Resolution 1244 on 10 June, a span of seventy-eight days; the ground entry began on 6 June. Scale: nineteen NATO states took part, with some six hundred aircraft and about fifty ships committed to the theatre at the outset; around 38,000 sorties were flown in the campaign as a whole, of which between 10,000 and 15,000 attacked targets in Serbia proper. Air losses: NATO lost two F-16s, one AH-1D Apache and one UH-60 Black Hawk, while one E-3 airborne warning aircraft and one F-117 were damaged but returned to base; the Yugoslavs claimed three or four NATO aircraft shot down and more than twelve aircraft and helicopters of their own lost. Ground losses: NATO's final accounting gave 1,458 dead in action and other causes and 4,074 wounded; the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia published 1,551 soldiers killed, 2,880 wounded and 928 missing between January and June 1999; the casualties of the Kosovo Liberation Army were never reliably counted, and by June 1999 roughly a quarter to a third of its fighters had demobilised or gone into hiding. Firepower and damage: NATO said it had destroyed or wrecked twenty-nine industrial plants and thirty-three power stations, putting roughly a third of the country's industrial capacity out of action; the single largest Yugoslav attack of the campaign was the salvo of more than sixty aircraft on 4 April. Air defence: the Yugoslavs claimed to have fired more than three hundred surface-to-air missiles, while NATO's own record of effective intercept engagements amounts to only a few dozen, and six launch batteries were destroyed in the first week. Strength: in March 1999 the army and militia in Kosovo together numbered about 100,000 men, and the armed strength of the Kosovo Liberation Army was estimated at 25,000 to 40,000; the KFOR authorised by Security Council Resolution 1199 in June had a ceiling of 60,000.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。第一層是科索沃在南斯拉夫聯盟內的地位問題：1974年南斯拉夫憲法給予科索沃自治省地位，1989至1990年米洛舍維奇以修改憲法的方式取消這項自治，阿爾巴尼亞族聚居區在失去自治之後面臨失業、歧視與警察鎮壓，青年人大量外流。1989年成立、1990年代轉為武裝的科索沃解放軍起初人數有限，1997年後轉為公開游擊，攻擊由鄉村路邊伏擊擴大到襲擊警察崗位與城鎮目標，與南軍特種部隊在科索沃北部的衝突不斷升高。第二層是1998年12月的朗布齊村襲擊：南塞武裝警察巡邏隊在姆特羅維察附近的朗布齊遭襲，多人陣亡，兇手其後被南軍擊斃，事件經媒體曝光後引發塞族方面的集會，也讓北約與歐盟的制裁授權面臨期限；1999年1月萊沙克村事件更令西方認定科索沃已無和平解決之道。第三層是外交手段用盡：歐安組織的核查團與監察機制無法阻止暴力，美國與歐盟在1998年推動的制裁與最後通牒未能迫使米洛舍維奇接受朗布齊協議，1998年9月安理會第1160號決議對南聯盟實施軍火禁運、第1194號決議則授權北約在特定條件下動用武力，此後數月的斡旋未能阻止3月24日的開打。第四層是西方對自身可信度的計算：1990年代的波黑、斯雷布雷尼察與盧安達案例，讓北約內部普遍認為若再次對大規模流血袖手旁觀，北約的威信將在俄羅斯面前崩潰；而俄羅斯的反對與中國的棄權，也讓南聯盟相信即使遭到空襲也不會被推翻。
causeEn: There were four layers of cause. The first was the standing of Kosovo inside the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia: the 1974 Yugoslav constitution gave Kosovo the status of an autonomous province, and in 1989 to 1990 Milošević cancelled that autonomy by amending the constitution, after which the Albanian-majority districts faced unemployment, discrimination and police repression, and large numbers of the young went abroad. The Kosovo Liberation Army, founded in 1989 and turned into an armed group during the 1990s, was small at first but from 1997 shifted to open insurgency, its attacks widening from roadside ambushes in the countryside to strikes on police posts and town targets, and clashes with army special units in the north of Kosovo grew steadily. The second layer was the Rambuzi attack of December 1998: an armed Serb police patrol near Mitrovica was ambushed at Rambuzi and several of its men were killed, and the attackers were then shot dead by the army; once the incident reached the press it triggered large Serb gatherings and put the deadlines on the Western sanctions and ultimatum in danger. The events at Račak in January 1999 persuaded the West that there was no peaceful solution left in Kosovo. The third layer was the exhaustion of diplomatic means: the verification and monitoring mechanisms of the OSCE could not stop the violence, and the sanctions and ultimatum pushed by the United States and the European Union in 1998 did not force Milošević to accept the Rambuzi agreement. Security Council Resolution 1160 of September 1998 imposed an arms embargo on Yugoslavia and Resolution 1194 authorised NATO to use force under specified conditions, and the months of mediation that followed failed to prevent the opening of hostilities on 24 March. The fourth layer was the Western calculation about its own credibility: Bosnia, Srebrenica and Rwanda in the 1990s left NATO convinced that standing aside again in the face of mass killing would collapse the alliance's standing in front of Russia, while Russian opposition and Chinese abstention convinced the Yugoslav leadership that it would not be overthrown even under air attack.
impact: 戰爭的後果分成國際、國內與長期三層。國際層：北約在沒有安理會新授權的情況下開戰，事後的合法性爭議一直延續到2010年國際法院的諮詢意見；北約隨後在2004年完成新一輪東擴，保加利亞、愛沙尼亞、拉脫維亞、立陶宛、羅馬尼亞、斯洛伐克與斯洛維尼亞加入，把前南斯拉夫地區的邊界正式寫進北約版圖；俄羅斯與北約的關係從此長期緊張，直到2010年代才逐漸修復。國內層：南斯拉夫聯盟在戰後被掏空，軍隊從科索沃全面撤回，1999年內有約三萬至四萬名軍人逃亡，軍心與政權的合法性同步崩塌；2000年9月米洛舍維奇在選舉中落敗並於10月遭到推翻，聯盟其後在2003年解散，改為塞爾維亞與黑山共和國，再在2006年經公民投票分家。長期層：科索沃解放軍被解散並改組為科索沃保護團與科索沃防衛軍，2008年單方面宣布獨立，國際法院2010年的諮詢意見認定單方面宣布獨立本身不違反國際法，同時指出它不對第三國產生法律義務，歐盟多數國家隨後承認，科索沃問題至今未解；這場戰爭也成為西方此後干預的先例，2003年伊拉克戰爭前後的政治辯論幾乎每一條都以科索沃為例。而南軍在戰役中暴露的防空與指揮體系問題，事後推動了塞爾維亞軍隊的重組與改革，直到2020年代仍在進行。
impactEn: The consequences of the war fall into three layers: international, domestic and long-term. On the international layer, NATO went to war without a fresh Security Council authorisation, and the dispute over the legality of that step ran on until the International Court of Justice delivered its advisory opinion in 2010. NATO then completed a new round of enlargement in 2004, with Bulgaria, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Romania, Slovakia and Slovenia joining, writing the boundaries of the former Yugoslav region firmly into the alliance's map, and the strained relationship with Russia was only gradually repaired during the 2010s. On the domestic layer, the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia was hollowed out: the army withdrew from Kosovo altogether, somewhere between thirty and forty thousand soldiers deserted during 1999, and the morale of the armed forces collapsed together with the legitimacy of the regime. Milošević was defeated in the elections of September 2000 and overthrown that October; the union was dissolved in 2003 and replaced by the State Union of Serbia and Montenegro, which in turn split by referendum in 2006. On the long-term layer, the Kosovo Liberation Army was disbanded and turned into the Kosovo Protection Corps and the Kosovo Defence Force; Kosovo declared independence unilaterally in 2008; the International Court of Justice held in 2010 that the unilateral declaration of independence was not itself contrary to international law, while also holding that it created no legal obligations for third states, and most EU states recognised it afterwards. The question remains open. The war also became the precedent for later Western intervention, and almost every line of the political debate before and after the Iraq war of 2003 cited Kosovo. And the weaknesses in the air-defence and command system exposed in the Yugoslav army prompted a reorganisation and reform of the Serbian armed forces that was still under way in the 2020s.
result: 點算結果要分軍事、政治與法律三層。軍事上，北約完成了預定目標：南斯拉夫人民軍自科索沃撤出，6月9日在庫馬諾沃簽署軍事技術協定，規定塞軍一個月內撤出科索沃並由國際部隊接替；南軍在西部的最後抵抗在6月上旬瓦解，6月10日安理會第1244號決議終止北約的空中行動，同時授權成立科索沃部隊與聯合國駐科索沃民政專責團。地面由科索沃解放軍與北約空襲合力取得的成果被制度化：6月6日KFOR進駐，6月26日在普里什蒂納機場與俄軍一度僵持，最後由北約與俄方協商解決。政治上，南聯盟內部的崩潰加速：1999年3月科索沃解放軍承認朗布齊村襲擊由其成員所為，阿德姆·德馬奇、哈希姆·塔奇等人先後被國際刑事法庭調查；1999年6月之後的每一次塞爾維亞總統選舉都把科索沃與科索沃解放軍的問題帶入選票，2000年米洛舍維奇倒台，科索沃戰爭遂成為塞爾維亞反對運動的起點。法律上，北約的開戰依據被解釋為安理會第1194號決議對南聯盟的譴責與北約自身的防衛理由，而非新的一致決議授權，這一點在日後的聯合國與學界論述中一直存在爭議。戰爭並沒有解決科索沃的歸屬問題，只把它從南聯盟內政改為國際化議題，並最終在2008年與2010年之後變成一個沒有終結的開放傷口。
resultEn: The result has to be counted on three levels: military, political and legal. Militarily NATO achieved its stated objectives. The Yugoslav Army withdrew from Kosovo, and on 9 June the Military-Technical Agreement was signed at Kumanovo, providing for the Serbian forces to leave Kosovo within a month and for international troops to take over. The last Yugoslav resistance in the west collapsed in the first days of June, and on 10 June Security Council Resolution 1244 ended the NATO air campaign while authorising the Kosovo Force and the United Nations Interim Administration Mission in Kosovo. The results achieved on the ground by the Kosovo Liberation Army together with the NATO air campaign were put into institutional form: the KFOR entered on 6 June, and on 26 June there was a standoff with Russian troops at Pristina airport, resolved by negotiation between NATO and the Russian side. Politically, the collapse inside the Yugoslav union was hastened. In March 1999 the Kosovo Liberation Army acknowledged that the Rambuzi attack had been carried out by its members, and Adem Demaçi, Hashim Thaçi and others were later investigated by the International Criminal Tribunal; every Serbian presidential election after June 1999 carried the questions of Kosovo and the KLA into the ballot, and the fall of Milošević in 2000 made the Kosovo war the starting point of the Serbian opposition movement. Legally, the basis for the war was read as the censure carried by Security Council Resolution 1194 together with NATO's own defence justification, rather than as a new authorisation by a unanimous resolution, and that reading has remained contested in subsequent United Nations and academic discussion. The war did not settle the question of Kosovo's status. It turned a domestic matter of the Yugoslav union into an internationalised issue, and after 2008 and 2010 it became an open wound with no closure.
